title: New Zealand extends parliamentary voting to women
summary: The Electoral Act signed on 19 September 1893 extended parliamentary voting to eligible women in New Zealand, including Māori women.

claims.text: The Electoral Act signed on 19 September 1893 extended parliamentary voting to eligible women in New Zealand, including Māori women.
Eligibility still depended on the law’s other requirements and exclusions. A broad suffrage milestone should not be represented as universal adult voting without qualification.
